messages.author: d3319c088176ee7b
messages.subject: Difficulty installing RStan on OS X Mavericks
parts:
I'm running OS X Mavericks v10.9.3 and R v3.1.0. I've successfully installed inline and Rcpp. My ~/.R/Makevars looks like this:

CXX=g++ -arch x86_64 -ftemplate-depth-256 -stdlib=libstdc++
CXXFLAGS="-mtune=native  -O3 -Wall -pedantic -Wconversion"

When I try to install RStan, the first compile fails. Here's what I see:

I had RStan working on an earlier version of Mac OS X and R 6-8 months ago, but I set it aside because I had other projects that needed my attention. I'd like to get it running again, and I'd greatly appreciate any advice.

Kent

messages.subject: Re: [stan-users] Re: Difficulty installing RStan on OS X Mavericks
parts:
In R's Makeconf file on Mac, there is

CPPFLAGS = -I/usr/local/include -I/usr/local/include/freetype2 -I/opt/X11/include

To find the path of this file, run the following code in R

R.home('etc')

So I guess one way is to change this file.  Or we can create another file called Makevars in ~/.R/ with the following included

CPPFLAGS =
